t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Go through each of the colours of gnome in order to see how many points you get. Once you've determined which ones reward the most, continue to select these ones, but do check that as they may change from time to time.

vb_textbox.text: Click each of the colours to see which one rewards the most points. Mostly, the gnomes that lead to a red basket reward higher, but this can change from time to time. Be sure to switch which colour you pick and stick with the higher rewarding colours most of the time.
